introduction: The National Sports Awards are presented annually by the President of India to honor excellence in sports. Traditionally announced around 'National Sports Day' (August 29), which celebrates the birth anniversary of hockey wizard Major Dhyan Chand. This foundational level covers the basic structure of India's premier sporting honors.

core_concepts.title: Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award
core_concepts.description: It is the highest sporting honor in India. It is awarded for the most spectacular and outstanding performance in the field of sports by a sportsperson over a period of the previous four years. In August 2021, it was renamed from 'Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna' to its current name.

core_concepts.title: Arjuna Award
core_concepts.description: Instituted in 1961, it is the second-highest sporting honor. It recognizes consistent outstanding performance for four years at the international level, combined with qualities of leadership, sportsmanship, and a sense of discipline.

core_concepts.title: Dronacharya Award
core_concepts.description: Instituted in 1985, this award is uniquely dedicated to 'Coaches' rather than players. It honors coaches who have consistently trained athletes or teams to achieve outstanding success at international events.

important_entities.name: Viswanathan Anand
important_entities.significance: India's first Chess Grandmaster, he became the inaugural recipient of the Khel Ratna Award.

important_entities.name: Major Dhyan Chand
important_entities.significance: A legendary Indian field hockey player who won three Olympic gold medals (1928, 1932, 1936). National Sports Day is celebrated on his birthday.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Aspirants often select a famous player when asked 'Who is eligible for the Dronacharya Award?'. Remember that in the Mahabharata, Dronacharya was a 'Guru' (teacher). Therefore, this award is strictly given to Sports Coaches, never to the athletes themselves.
If a question asks for India's highest sporting honor and 'Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna' is not in the options, look for 'Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna'. They are the exact same award.

mnemonics_and_tricks.memory_phrase: Arjuna shoots the arrow, Dronacharya teaches how
mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Arjuna Award = For the Athletes (Players). Dronacharya Award = For the Mentors (Coaches).

exam_strategy_tips: Direct questions regarding the date of National Sports Day (August 29) and the first Khel Ratna winner (Viswanathan Anand) are staples in Tier-1 SSC and Railway exams.
